verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a sandbox environment that is completely separate from production, so integrations can be tested through simulations without real money (docs-14). Its developer connector explicitly links AI coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code and Codex to the sandbox, which suits the AI-native angle (docs-12). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox, and detail on how far the sandbox mirrors production behavior.
